text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: gpu_ecc_correctable spikes in us-west-2a - A100 pool. 120 correctables across 8 cards in 10m. Auto-drain didn't trigger (threshold=500/5m).

kai: saw the alert, pulling logs now. any idea if this is a single noisy card or broad?

marta: quick grep shows same host (gpu-node-uw2a-14) contributing ~70 of those. others are 5-10 each.

oliver: can you paste the per-card rates?

marta: "card 0: 0.35/s, card 1: 0.02/s, card 2: 0.01/s, card 3: 0.18/s, card 4: 0.5/s, card 5: 0.04/s, card 6: 0.03/s, card 7: 0.27/s"

jen: so one or two noisy cards on that node plus small background noise. we should avoid cluster-wide drains for this.

kai: agree. current auto-drain policy is too coarse: it uses absolute cluster-level rate (500/5m). that misses small single-node storms but also prevents action on mid-size spikes.

oliver: proposal: add a per-card circuit-breaker that triggers soft-drain if a single card exceeds 0.3/s sustained for 10m OR if a node has >60% of cluster correctables in 15m. soft-drain = mark workloads un-schedulable and migrate in background, not immediate kill.

marta: +1 for per-card CB. also add a debounce window (15m) and a backoff so we don't flip-flop on intermittent noise.

jen: we also need capacity-aware behavior: if region spare capacity < 10% we should instead throttle new allocations and flag for ops, not drain. us-west-2 is at 12% spare right now so soft-drain ok but watch closely.

kai: implementing heuristic:
```
if per_card_rate(card) > 0.3/s for 10m -> soft_drain(card)
else if cluster_rate > 1000/5m -> hard_drain(node)
apply debounce 15m per card
respect region_spare_threshold = 10%
```

oliver: please add a metric and alert for "soft_drain_in_progress" and a rollback timer of 2h after which we auto-unmark if errors drop <0.01/s.

marta: I've run a smoke runbook against gpu-node-uw2a-14: kernel logs show repeated ECC correctable events with nvdriver xid entries, and dmesg shows occasional PCI link retrain. ops should schedule card replacement for that host.

jen: ticket created: INFRA-6278 - replace flaky A100 on gpu-node-uw2a-14. tagging oncall for tomorrow.

kai: action items: 1) eng-infra to land per-card circuit-breaker + debounce (PR by EOD), 2) add soft_drain metrics/alerts (oliver), 3) ops replace card INFRA-6278 (marta/ops), 4) adjust auto-drain doc with capacity-aware rules (jen).

jen: will schedule canary rollout to 10% of clusters first (us-west and eu-west). monitor for false positives for 48h.

marta: interim: manually soft-drained gpu-node-uw2a-14, migrations in progress, tokenized workloads moving off. monitoring-bot will post updates. :thumbsup:

monitoring-bot: note: soft_drain started for gpu-node-uw2a-14 at 1890122800, migrations 3/4, current per-card error on that node down from 0.5/s to 0.02/s

kai: nice. keep an eye on oscillation. if we see repeated reoccurrence after replacement, escalate to vendor.

oliver: PR link when ready? i'll review the change to the rule engine and metric names.

jen: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/pcb-ecc-cb (WIP)

marta: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if noise returns or the canary shows unexpected drains.
